ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low-intensity dominance. Approximately 98% of visible pixels are in the 0-50 intensity range (black/dark grey), with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to specular water reflections and localized scarring marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark region across the entirety of both lobes. High-contrast white focal spots are present as small, non-geometric clusters representing linear scratches and a large irregular cluster on the far-left distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 82 degrees. The notch depth is significant, penetrating roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge. The right lobe distal margin exhibits a higher frequency of fine, jagged peaks compared to the smoother inner trailing edge closer to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, with the tips tapering upward and outward in a symmetrical sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups localized on the far-left distal tip, consistent with barnacle-related scarring or active colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous fine, white, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; most notably a vertical scratch on the left central lobe and horizontal-leaning marks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, bulbous protrusion/growth on the extreme distal edge of the left fluke lobe, breaking the continuous geometric contour.
